_gate: THREE LIMBS (PREREGISTRATION.md section 6). A: GPU execution, binary and physics-critical -- the three tells of smoke_test_gpu_path.sh in this case's OWN run record at every level, AND the forced-CPU arm of the same level showing GPU-ABSENT (tell 1 cannot discriminate alone; the forced-CPU control IS the discriminator, and a leaking control REFUSES). B: |v_GPU - v_CPU|/|v_CPU| <= 1e-4 at four radii x three levels. C: |v_GPU - v_exact|/|v_exact| <= 0.02 at the finest level, against the closed form the comparator EVALUATES ITSELF: v_theta(r) = omega R_i^2 (R_o^2 - r^2)/(r (R_o^2 - R_i^2)) = 0.0151201/0.0105336/0.00718656/0.00454781 m/s at r = 20/25/30/35 mm. The manual's printed 2-s.f. column and its Ansys Fluent GPU column are CONTEXT ONLY.
